name: Appartements Resi Eisenmann
beschreibung: Appartements Resi Eisenmann is situated on the outskirts of Söll, a charming village in the Brixental valley. The holiday apartments offer functional accommodation for self-catering guests eager to explore the Kitzbühel Alps. The local ski resort and village centre are easily accessible by car or public transport. Amenities include an equipped kitchen and a private balcony or terrace. Families and couples alike will find here a convenient base for exploring and enjoying outdoor activities in the region.
